blind.description: An ornate, gilded reliquary or jewelry casket standing on four small rounded feet. It features a rectangular body with decorative golden relief panels, adorned at the corners with red and green gemstone cabochons, and a prominent circular white pearl or opal set in the center front. The lid is hipped/pyramidal with golden filigree patterns and a red jewel at the central apex. Surfaces are clean, solid, and fully continuous without floating shards or holes.
blind.from_above: A rectangular golden lid with diagonal ridges converging to a central red square jewel, surrounded by four corner knobs topped with colored gems (one green, three red) and feet projecting slightly at the corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall and 1 foot wide, roughly one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
